eyeGeometryConcept.title: High-Quality Capture of Eyes
eyeGeometryConcept.use: Interdependence of cornea/sclera shape, iris detail and refracted appearance. This study does not replicate capture or measured personal anatomy.

thicknessContext.title: Terahertz sensing in corneal tissues
thicknessContext.use: Introduction describes roughly0.55mm corneal thickness. A constant whole-envelope normal offset here is an artistic approximation, not a measured variable-thickness cornea or a THz optical material model.

nominalIORScope: Outer1.376 inherited from existing source; aqueous1.336 and relative-interface ratio are illustrative optical assumptions, not calibrated to an individual or independently validated Cycles nested-medium transport.

nextLidBasis.title: Detailed Spatio-Temporal Reconstruction of Eyelids
nextLidBasis.use: Treat visible contour, rolling skin, occlusion and eyelashes as a coherent deformation problem rather than another isolated crease.
